testCase.name: ProGuard Rule Missing
testCase.description: Runtime crash in release build due to obfuscation

metadata.context: Gson reflection methods removed by R8

expectedFix.explanation: Add ProGuard keep rule for serialization classes

agent_response.rootCause: ProGuard removed the method getUserName() from User class at User.kt line 45, causing NoSuchMethodError at runtime in MainActivity.kt line 102.
fixGuidelines: 1. Edit proguard-rules.pro to preserve getUserName(), add -keep method for com.example.User { public java.lang.String getUserName(); }
2. Check build.gradle.kts: ensure minification is disabled or rules are correctly set up to prevent removal of necessary methods
3. Verify by running ./gradlew assembleRelease and checking the usage.txt file for preserved method
